summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The Global X S&P 500 Tail Risk ETF (XTR) is an exchange-traded fund that is based on the Cboe S&P 500 Tail Risk index. The fund tracks an index of the S&P 500 stocks and aims to protect the fund from significant negative movements or tail risk by purchasing quarterly Index put options. XTR was launched on Aug 25, 2021 and is issued by Global X.

holdings.infoBox: XTR is an equity ETF with a total of 506 individual holdings. The top holdings are NVIDIA stock at 8.27%, Apple at 7.23%, Microsoft at 5.68%, Alphabet at 5.42%, and Amazon.com at 3.64%.
